_meta.purpose: Single canonical record of every speculative branch / hypothesis raised by any AI session, user research, or experimental pilot in the Hs / CNT / CNQ project. Each investigation is classified by disposition (CANONICAL / DEFERRED / FALSIFIED / OPEN) and carries gate criteria stating what would (or did) cause it to graduate, fail, or move forward.
_meta.rationale: The framework treats compositional data as a living record where every contribution above the EITT 5% threshold counts as a carrier; below 5% it doesn't make the cut. The same discipline applies to research investigations: every speculative branch is data, and the disposition record is the audit trail. This catalog is the project's research-methodology equivalent of the determinism contract: the path of every idea is traceable.

dispositions.CANONICAL: Met its promotion gate. Lives in the repo. Binding doctrine, code, or schema.
dispositions.DEFERRED: Mathematically coherent or experimentally proposed, but unvalidated. Archived; awaits a pilot or computational verification before promotion.
dispositions.FALSIFIED: Tested (experimentally or analytically) and refuted. Kept on record as part of the audit trail and to prevent re-exploration of the same dead end.
dispositions.OPEN: Raised, in progress, gate criteria stated, awaiting resolution. May be assigned to a person/AI or unassigned.

investigations.title: HCI Dyadic Coupling Ladder — order-2 / 4 / 8 tensor diagnostic for pair-of-pairs coupling
investigations.summary: Recursive dyadic tensor ladder. Order-2 = current core (kappa^HS_ij). Order-4 (C_ijkl = Cov_t(kappa^HS_ij(t), kappa^HS_kl(t))) detects pair-of-pairs coupling, multi-attractor structure, and parallel pair-processing. Order-8 (B_ijklmnop) only when order-4 structures themselves become objects of comparison. Distinct from D=8 carrier dimension; this is the tensor-analysis layer.
investigations.gate_for_promotion: Working pilot showing C_ijkl detects an attractor or coupling structure that order-2 kappa^HS_ij misses, on a real corpus experiment OR a synthetically constructed test case where the multi-attractor structure is known a priori.
investigations.risk_note: Order-4 is a real next analytical object; order-8 is recursive and should NOT be invoked speculatively without an order-4 attractor structure to motivate it. Mathematical use of 'rank' is reserved for matrix/tensor decomposition; 'order' is the correct term for index count.

investigations.title: CNQ Twin-Quaternion Factoring — D=8 SU(2) x SU(2) decomposition into two coupled quaternion paths (legacy name: 'bi-quaternion')
investigations.summary: For a D=8 compositional trajectory, factor into two coupled unit-quaternion paths q_A(t), q_B(t) via the SO(8) sup SU(2) x SU(2) decomposition. Cross-factor product R_AB(t) = q_A * q_B^{-1}; factor correlation rho_AB. Recommended first-pilot target: EMBER country trajectories (D=8 power-source carriers, natural fossil/non-fossil partition).
investigations.terminology_note_push_27: Originally proposed as 'bi-quaternion factoring'. Per NOTATION_AND_TERMINOLOGY.md sect 7 / sect 12, the formal name is 'twin-quaternion factoring' to disambiguate from strict mathematical bi-quaternions (H tensor C). Legacy filename CNQ_BIQUATERNION_FACTORING.md and dimension label 'bi_quaternion_factoring_candidate' in cnq.py v1.0.0 retained for repo-history continuity.
investigations.gate_for_promotion: Working pilot on EMBER D=8 country trajectory showing factor-correlation rho_AB carries domain-meaningful signal (e.g. fossil/non-fossil transition timeline), validated against parent CNT termination/IR class. Implementation lands in cnq.py via --twin-quaternion flag with deterministic output.
investigations.risk_note: Algebraically grounded (SO(8) factoring is standard) but framework-specific value depends on whether rho_AB carries information CNT alone does not expose. Demonstration-first discipline applies. Scaffolded in cnq.py v1.0.0 via the dimension label 'bi_quaternion_factoring_candidate' (no factoring code yet).
investigations.promotion_notes: Twin-quaternion factoring graduates from DEFERRED scaffolding to load-bearing native at D=8. hci_shared.factoring.twin_quaternion_factor + CHSH integration in CNQ v2. Algebra label corrected from earlier loose math.

investigations.promotion_notes: P2 attractor parameter fit (period, period_stability, dominant_pair, contraction_lambda, amplitude_A, damping_zeta) emitted by both CNT v3 and CNQ v2 via shared hci_shared.attractors module. 1-D limit cycle case handled (relative-variance threshold + degenerate-pair fallback).

investigations.title: CHSH Correlation Diagnostic — Tsirelson-direction joint quaternion-log sign correlations
investigations.summary: Compute CHSH-S parameter from joint quaternion-log signs along Tsirelson-optimal directions: n_a=(1,0,0), n_a'=(0,1,0), n_b=(1,1,0)/sqrt(2), n_b'=(1,-1,0)/sqrt(2). Four correlators AB, AB', A'B, A'B'; S = |AB + AB' + A'B - A'B'|; classical bound 2.0; Tsirelson bound 2*sqrt(2) ≈ 2.828. Lands as new module HCI-CNQ/engine/correlations.py. The math is standard quantum-information CHSH; the novelty is computing it on compositional-trajectory quaternion logs.
investigations.gate_for_promotion: HARD PREREQUISITE: a multi-channel dataset (not a single trajectory). Round 3 corpus must reveal at least one experiment with measurable joint-channel correlations that warrant the analysis. Without multi-channel data, CHSH on a single trajectory is just a self-correlation and doesn't measure anything novel. The Joint Quaternion Field construction (combining multiple subsystems with weights from the simplex) is the logical prerequisite — see related Helmsman dynamics in INV-033.
investigations.risk_note: Tempting to compute on single-trajectory data and report S values. Don't — that's self-correlation, not joint correlation. CHSH's interpretive power requires genuine multi-system / multi-channel structure. The framework's first multi-channel candidates are EMBER country trajectories (D=8 with natural fossil/non-fossil partition) and HCI-AUDIO 4-driver psychoacoustic data.
investigations.narrative: ai-refresh/AI_REFRESH_2026-05-08_push30_grok_round3_catalog.md
investigations.promotion_notes: CHSH joint coherence diagnostic ships in hci_shared.factoring.chsh_S_value. Load-bearing at D=8 (computed on twin-quaternion factor outputs). Classical bound 2.0 and Tsirelson bound 2*sqrt(2) emitted in output for reference.

Within-language determinism is byte-identical; cross-language parity is per-field at 1e-13 tolerance.

Companion verity.json is machine-readable. Release gate: unverified_count == 0.

Receipts are independently verifiable via canonical_sha256(body − {hash field}). Aggregate verdicts: ALL_PASS / SOME_FAILED / SOME_SKIPPED / INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL.

promotion_rules.from_OPEN_to_CANONICAL: Investigation must meet its stated gate_criteria. Promotion requires updating disposition, adding canonical_location, and citing the verification record (commit, pilot report, or experiment JSON).
promotion_rules.from_OPEN_to_DEFERRED: Investigation has been considered but pilots are deferred. May reflect resource priority, regulatory dependency, or conflict with current discipline (demonstration-first).
promotion_rules.from_OPEN_to_FALSIFIED: Investigation tested against gate_criteria and refuted. Falsification record must capture: what was tested, what was expected, what was observed, and any reformulation that survives.
promotion_rules.from_DEFERRED_to_CANONICAL: Pilot grounds the speculation. Same gate as OPEN→CANONICAL.
promotion_rules.from_DEFERRED_to_FALSIFIED: Pilot run, refuted. Standard falsification record.
promotion_rules.from_CANONICAL_to_RETIRED: Reserved for future use. Currently no canonical artifact has been retired.

how_to_add_a_new_investigation: 1. Append a new entry to the investigations array with the next sequential id (INV-NNN).
2. Required fields: id, title, raised_by, raised_date, raised_in_push, disposition, summary, gate_criteria.
3. If disposition is CANONICAL, also include promotion_date, canonical_location, and gate_outcome.
4. If disposition is DEFERRED, include deferred_to_location and gate_for_promotion.
5. If disposition is FALSIFIED, include falsification_date, falsification_record, and any reformulation.
6. If disposition is OPEN, include gate_for_promotion and (optionally) promotion_owner and estimated_effort_days.
8. Cross-reference from any new push narrative or AI-refresh document that introduces or moves the investigation.
